crossRefs.note: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”
He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay…
Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

translations.web: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
translations.bsb: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.
translations.kjv: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
translations.asv: So when they got out upon the land, they see a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
